versions.changelog: 1. Added: credentialExpectations, filesystemWrites, and warning metadata for ClawScan. 新增：凭据声明、文件写入范围和警告元数据，适配 ClawScan。

1. Added: Browser-session credential declaration with account verification and cleanup steps. 新增：浏览器会话凭据声明，含账户确认和使用后清理步骤。 2. Added: Data disclosure for read-mode context exposure. 新增：读取模式上下文暴露的数据披露。 3. Restructured: Security declaration with credential, data, and operation sections. 重构：安全声明分为凭据、数据、操作限制三个部分。
1. Shorten the bilingual summary so both English and Chinese appear in ClawHub preview cards. 缩短双语简介，确保 ClawHub 预览卡片同时显示英文和中文。

1. Add verified Douyin video/note comment workflows, including modal_id handling, comment reading, sentiment brief guidance, and explicit confirmation rules for external interactions. 新增已验证的抖音视频/图文评论区流程，包括 modal_id 处理、评论读取、情绪简报指引，以及外部互动写入的明确确认规则。
1. Fix H1 title to match frontmatter: Douyin Messager | 抖音私信助手. 2. Add Prerequisites section declaring openclaw browser profile requirement and security scope. 修复标题与 frontmatter 不一致，增加前置要求章节。
1. Fix display name to proper format: Douyin Messager | 抖音私信助手. 修复显示名称为正确格式。
Fix subprocess.run(shell=True) in record_audio.py for security compliance. 修复 record_audio.py 中 subprocess.run(shell=True) 调用，提升安全性。

Improve cross-platform behavior with automatic Windows/macOS detection. 优化跨平台行为，新增 Windows/macOS 自动识别。
Make DM panel navigation more reliable with JS-based targeting. 用 JS 定位提升 DM 面板导航稳定性。
Fix Draft.js input by switching to clipboard paste + Enter dispatch. 通过剪贴板粘贴 + Enter 派发修复 Draft.js 输入兼容性。
Support both pinned-contact and search-based messaging flows. 同时支持置顶联系人与搜索用户两种发信流程。
Add full end-to-end examples for both methods. 新增两套完整可跑通的端到端示例。
Clean up outdated footer metadata. 清理过时的页脚元数据。
Refined skill wording and publishing readiness. 优化技能表述并整理为更适合发布的版本。
Optimized triggers for higher sensitivity: added douyin dm, message, chat, history keywords. 优化激活词提高灵敏度：增加 douyin dm、message、chat、history 等关键词。
首个版本：支持抖音私信发送、获取聊天记录、处理 xdg-open 弹窗问题
